svg.title: Compostito - isometric cutaway
svg.text: The home unit from the 2024 patent, prototype 2 proportions. Front walls removed; chamber A lifted to show the coil in B.
Intake hatch on the lid: fresh waste
Aluminium coil (Ø19 mm, 3 m) cast in a
Solid PVC floors hold moisture between
Drip line keeps B at 50-60 % moisture
VB low vent: fresh air in
VH high vent: warm, moist air out
Warm air rises through the mesh (chimney effect).
Indicative proportions derived from the prototype bill of materials, not a verified build.
